Quick start

Talk to the RuneClans hub from your Discord bot (or anything on Java 17+). The SDK handles the key, the hub's rate limits and retries, so your code is just the calls.

  1. Add the SDK (JitPack, from this repository's tags): 
    <repositories>
    <repository><id>jitpack.io</id><url>https://jitpack.io</url></repository>
</repositories>
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.github.metorrite</groupId>
    <artifactId>runeclan-sdk</artifactId>
    <version>v0.2.0</version>
</dependency>

    Gradle: maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' } and implementation 'com.github.metorrite:runeclan-sdk:v0.2.0'.

  2. Give it your key: set RUNECLAN_API_KEY=rsh_..., or put apiKey=rsh_... in a runeclan.properties file next to your bot (and add that file to .gitignore). No key yet? See Getting a key.
  3. Connect once and call: 
    RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect();   // checks the key with the hub

hub.players().byDiscordId(userId).queue(player -> {
    if (player.isEmpty()) event.reply("Link your RuneScape account first.").queue();
    else event.reply("You are " + player.get().characters().get(0).rsn()).queue();
});

Keep the one hub for your whole bot: it is safe to share between threads. Full programs to copy are under Examples.

Getting a key

Ask the hub for a key once. A person approves each request (and may grant fewer scopes than you asked for).

curl -s -X POST "$RUNECLAN_API_URL/v1/apps/requests" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Clan Helper","description":"Shows our members' drops in our server.","contactEmail":"you@example.org",
       "discordApplicationId":"<your bot application id>","scopes":["players:read","events:read","guilds:write"]}'

The answer has a requestId and a claimSecret (shown once: keep it). Once approved, collect the key:

curl -s -X POST "$RUNECLAN_API_URL/v1/apps/requests/$REQUEST_ID/claim" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"claimSecret":"rshc_..."}'

409 pending means not decided yet, 403 refused, 410 already_claimed once collected. The answer holds apiKey (rsh_...), shown once. Store it as a secret: never in git, never in a log.

RUNECLAN_API_URL is https://api.runeclans.com; the SDK uses that address unless you set another.

Making calls

Every method answers an ApiAction, like JDA's RestAction. Nothing is sent until you pick how to run it:

You writeWhat happens
.complete()Sends the call and waits for the answer. Use it on your own worker or virtual thread.
.submit()Gives a CompletableFuture.
.queue(ok, failed)Runs your callback when the answer comes. Never blocks a JDA listener. Without failed, a failure is logged.
.map(f)A new action that changes the answer before you get it.

Lookups (get, byName, byDiscordId, ...) answer an Optional: empty for "not found" or "not yours to see". Lists come a page at a time (limit 1 to 200, a cursor for the next page); the all...() methods follow the pages for you.

Players decide what you see. A player shows up only after they grant your app access, as an alias (a1_...) only your app gets; a Discord id only with their identity grant. A player can limit the grant to some servers: read for one server with hub.forGuild(guildId).

Any route: every public operation is in Routes, so a route with no friendly method yet is still one call:

EventStandingsAnswer table = hub.route(Routes.GET_EVENTS_EVENT_ID_STANDINGS)
        .path("eventId", eventId)
        .as(EventStandingsAnswer.class)
        .complete();
On route(...)Does
.path(name, value)Fills {name} in the path (encoded for you).
.query(name, value)Adds ?name=value; a null value is left out.
.header(name, value) / .guild(id)Adds a header / X-Guild-Id.
.body(object)A JSON body (a Map, a record, a JsonNode).
.idempotent()Adds an Idempotency-Key so a write is safe to send again (see Retries).
.as(Type.class), .asOptional(..), .asJson(), .asBytes(), .send()How to read the answer: a type, an Optional (404 = empty), JSON, bytes, or nothing.

Scopes

Your key carries scopes. Each call needs the one listed beside it (routes marked any key need none). The SDK knows your scopes from the start-up handshake, so a call your key can't make fails at once (missing_scope, local() true) instead of being sent. Got a new scope? hub.refreshHandshake().

ScopeLets youUsed by
players:readList and read the players who granted your app.GET /v1/players, GET /v1/players/by-rsn/{rsn}, GET /v1/players/{alias}, GET /v1/guilds/{guildId}/players, GET /v1/players/{alias}/everything, POST /v1/players/stats
events:readTheir RuneSync events and XP, in the categories they share with you.GET /v1/players/{alias}/events, GET /v1/guilds/{guildId}/events, GET /v1/players/{alias}/logs, GET /v1/guilds/{guildId}/logs/race, GET /v1/players/{alias}/xp, POST /v1/guilds/{guildId}/xp/gains and 4 more
links:readLook a player up by Discord id, only if they granted you their identity.GET /v1/links/discord/{discordId}
guilds:writeRegister your Discord servers and which granted players are in them.PUT /v1/guilds/{guildId}, DELETE /v1/guilds/{guildId}, PUT /v1/guilds/{guildId}/members/{alias}, DELETE /v1/guilds/{guildId}/members/{alias}
feed:readRead your app's change feed.GET /v1/feed
webhooks:manageAdd, list, test and remove webhooks (at most 5).GET /v1/webhooks, POST /v1/webhooks, DELETE /v1/webhooks/{id}, POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/ping, POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/resume
polls:readA clan's polls and results (anonymous polls: counts only).GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/polls, GET /v1/polls/{pollId}, GET /v1/polls/{pollId}/results
signups:readA clan's signups and group-finder posts.GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/signups, GET /v1/signups/{id}, GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/groups/settings, GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/groups, GET /v1/groups/{id}
forms:readA clan's web forms.GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/forms, GET /v1/forms/{formId}
economy:readA clan's points, coffer, Citadel wheel and giveaways.GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/points/settings, GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/points/balances, GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/points/ledger, GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/points/submissions, GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/points/rewards, GET /v1/clans/{clanId}/points/redemptions and 9 more
features:reportTell the hub what your bot offers, per server.PUT /v1/apps/me/capabilities, PUT /v1/guilds/{guildId}/capabilities

Rate limits

Limits are per key, as a bucket that refills every minute:

TierCalls a minuteBurst
standard60120Every new key.
partner6001200Bigger bots, by agreement.

Your key's real numbers come from the handshake (hub.handshake().get().rateLimit()). The SDK paces itself to them, so it waits for a free slot instead of sending a call it knows will be refused. Every answer carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset, which keep the pacing honest when several copies of your bot share one key.

Retries and outages

  • 429: the SDK waits the hub's Retry-After (up to 60 s, set maxRetryWait) and sends the call again. A longer wait comes to you as rate_limited with retryAfter().
  • Lost connection, 502, 503, 504: reads and PUTs are sent again (3 tries in all, with backoff).
  • POST and DELETE are never sent again blind: the first one may have worked. Mark a write with .idempotent() on a route(...) call and it becomes safe to repeat: the hub answers a repeat within 24 hours with the first answer instead of doing it twice.

The hub checks every key, scope and limit itself: the SDK's checks only save you wasted calls.

Errors

Everything that fails throws (or completes the future with) a RuneClanException:

MethodGives
status()The HTTP status, or 0 when no answer came back.
code()The hub's error code (below), or one of the SDK's own.
getMessage()Plain words you can log.
retryAfter()Seconds to wait, for a 429.
body()The hub's whole error answer, as JSON.
local()True when nothing was sent (the SDK stopped it).
isNotFound(), isRateLimited()Shortcuts.
try {
    hub.players().events(alias, "XP", null, null, 20).complete();
} catch (RuneClanException e) {
    switch (e.code()) {
        case "missing_scope" -> log.warn("Ask for events:read on the key");
        case "not_found" -> log.info("Unknown player, or they didn't grant us");
        default -> log.error("Hub said " + e.status() + " " + e.code() + ": " + e.getMessage());
    }
}

The SDK's own codes

CodeMeans
missing_scopeYour key lacks the scope the call needs. With local() true the SDK caught it before sending anything.
unreachableNo connection to the hub (after the SDK's own retries for safe calls).
timeoutSent, but no answer in time: it may have happened. Writes are not sent again on their own.
interruptedYour thread was interrupted while waiting.
bad_answerThe hub answered something the SDK couldn't read.
sdk_too_old426: the hub no longer serves this SDK version. Update the SDK.
rate_limited429 that lasted longer than maxRetryWait (default 60 s). retryAfter() says how long.
Every hub error code (354)

Errors are {"error": "<code>", "message": "<words>"}. The most common: 401 no or bad key, 403 missing_scope, 404 not_found (also "not yours to see"), 429 rate_limited, 426 sdk_too_old.

Settings

Everything has a default; change only what you need:

RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect(RuneClanConfig.builder()
        .apiKey(System.getenv("MY_KEY_NAME"))      // or leave out: RUNECLAN_API_KEY, then runeclan.properties
        .baseUrl("http://localhost:8090")           // another hub, e.g. a local one
        .requestTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
        .maxAttempts(3)
        .maxRetryWait(Duration.ofSeconds(60))
        .executor(myExecutor)                       // runs submit()/queue(); virtual threads on Java 21+
        .userAgent("my-bot/1.4")
        .build());
WhereWhat
RUNECLAN_API_KEYThe key (handy on hosts like Railway).
RUNECLAN_API_URLThe hub's address (default https://api.runeclans.com).
RUNECLAN_CONFIGA key file somewhere other than ./runeclan.properties.
OrderWhat you pass in code, then the environment, then the file. The SDK never logs the key.

Testing your bot

Pass a FakeTransport and nothing touches the network. Answers are served in order; the first one is the handshake.

FakeTransport fake = new FakeTransport()
        .answer(200, "{\"appId\":\"a\",\"scopes\":[\"players:read\"]}")        // the handshake
        .answer(200, "{\"alias\":\"a1_x\",\"characters\":[]}");
RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect(RuneClanConfig.builder().apiKey(testKey).transport(fake).build());
// ... call your code, then look at fake.requests()

ApiAction.of(value) makes a ready answer for your own fakes. See the TestingYourBot example.

Examples

Whole programs, each one checked by the SDK's own tests so they keep working. Click one to open it.

AnyRouteEvery public hub operation is in Routes, even the ones with no friendly method yet. route(...) still gets the SDK's scope check, pacing and retries. forGuild(...) reads for one Discord server (players may limit their grant to some servers).

File examples/AnyRoute.java. Run it with java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson-databind.jar:jackson-core.jar:jackson-annotations.jar examples/AnyRoute.java (Java 17+, no build needed).

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClan;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanClient;
import com.runeclans.sdk.Routes;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.EventPage;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * Every public hub operation is in Routes, even the ones with no friendly method yet. route(...) still gets the SDK's scope check,
 * pacing and retries. forGuild(...) reads for one Discord server (players may limit their grant to some servers).
 */
public class AnyRoute {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try (RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect()) {
            run(hub, args[0], args[1], System.out);
        }
    }

    static void run(RuneClanClient hub, String guildId, String alias, PrintStream out) {
        // A typed answer: the generated record for the route's JSON.
        EventPage drops = hub.forGuild(guildId)
                .route(Routes.GET_PLAYERS_ALIAS_EVENTS)
                .path("alias", alias)
                .query("category", "DROPS")
                .query("limit", 10)
                .as(EventPage.class)
                .complete();
        out.println(drops.data().size() + " recent drop(s)");

        // Or plain JSON when you only need a field or two.
        JsonNode top = hub.route(Routes.GET_GUILDS_GUILD_ID_XP_LEADERBOARD).path("guildId", guildId).query("period", "week").asJson().complete();
        out.println("This week's XP leaderboard: " + top.path("players").size() + " player(s)");
    }
}
EventStandingsEvents clans share publicly (competitions, bingos), with the standings of each running one. Any key may read them.

File examples/EventStandings.java. Run it with java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson-databind.jar:jackson-core.jar:jackson-annotations.jar examples/EventStandings.java (Java 17+, no build needed).

import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClan;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanClient;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.Event;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.EventList;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.EventStandingsAnswer;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * Events clans share publicly (competitions, bingos), with the standings of each running one. Any key may read them.
 */
public class EventStandings {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try (RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect()) {
            run(hub, System.out);
        }
    }

    static void run(RuneClanClient hub, PrintStream out) {
        EventList shared = hub.events().shared(null, null, null).complete();   // null = defaults (public events)
        for (Event e : shared.events()) {
            out.println(e.name() + " [" + e.status() + "]");
            if (!"RUNNING".equals(e.status())) continue;
            EventStandingsAnswer table = hub.events().standings(e.id()).complete();
            for (EventStandingsAnswer.StandingsItem row : table.standings()) {
                out.println("  " + (row.place() == null ? "-" : row.place()) + ". " + row.name() + "  " + row.points() + " pts");
            }
        }
    }
}
FeedPollerCatch up on everything that changed for your app (new plugin events, grants changed, links made or ended), oldest first. Needs feed:read. Save nextCursor somewhere that survives a restart; "more" means there is another page right now. Run it every minute or so (or use webhooks, see WebhookReceiver).

File examples/FeedPoller.java. Run it with java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson-databind.jar:jackson-core.jar:jackson-annotations.jar examples/FeedPoller.java (Java 17+, no build needed).

import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClan;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanClient;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.FeedEntry;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.FeedPage;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;

/**
 * Catch up on everything that changed for your app (new plugin events, grants changed, links made or ended), oldest first.
 * Needs feed:read. Save nextCursor somewhere that survives a restart; "more" means there is another page right now.
 * Run it every minute or so (or use webhooks, see WebhookReceiver).
 */
public class FeedPoller {
    static final Path CURSOR_FILE = Path.of("feed-cursor.txt");

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        try (RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect()) {
            String cursor = Files.exists(CURSOR_FILE) ? Files.readString(CURSOR_FILE).strip() : null;
            String next = run(hub, cursor, System.out);
            if (next != null) Files.writeString(CURSOR_FILE, next);
        }
    }

    /** Reads every page after {@code cursor} and answers the cursor to store. */
    static String run(RuneClanClient hub, String cursor, PrintStream out) {
        FeedPage page;
        do {
            page = hub.feed().after(cursor, 100).complete();
            for (FeedEntry e : page.data()) out.println(e.createdAt() + " " + e.kind() + " " + e.alias());
            if (page.nextCursor() != null) cursor = page.nextCursor();
        } while (Boolean.TRUE.equals(page.more()));
        return cursor;
    }
}
GuildSyncTell the hub which Discord server your bot is in and which granted players are its members, then read the server's players. Needs guilds:write (writes) and players:read (reads). Register and addMember are PUTs: safe to repeat, so run them on every start.

File examples/GuildSync.java. Run it with java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson-databind.jar:jackson-core.jar:jackson-annotations.jar examples/GuildSync.java (Java 17+, no build needed).

import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClan;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanClient;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.Player;

import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Tell the hub which Discord server your bot is in and which granted players are its members, then read the server's players.
 * Needs guilds:write (writes) and players:read (reads). Register and addMember are PUTs: safe to repeat, so run them on every start.
 */
public class GuildSync {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try (RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect()) {
            run(hub, args[0], "My clan server", List.of(args).subList(1, args.length), System.out);
        }
    }

    static void run(RuneClanClient hub, String guildId, String guildName, List<String> memberAliases, PrintStream out) {
        hub.guilds().register(guildId, guildName).complete();
        for (String alias : memberAliases) hub.guilds().addMember(guildId, alias).complete();

        int count = 0;
        for (Player p : hub.guilds().allPlayers(guildId)) {   // follows nextCursor page by page for you
            out.println(p.alias() + " -> " + (p.characters().isEmpty() ? "no RSN" : p.characters().get(0).rsn()));
            count++;
        }
        out.println(count + " player(s) in " + guildName);
    }
}
HandlingErrorsEverything that fails is a RuneClanException with the HTTP status and the hub's error code. Lookups answer an empty Optional for a 404 instead. The SDK already waits out 429s and retries safe calls after an outage, so you only see what is left.

File examples/HandlingErrors.java. Run it with java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson-databind.jar:jackson-core.jar:jackson-annotations.jar examples/HandlingErrors.java (Java 17+, no build needed).

import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClan;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanClient;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanException;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * Everything that fails is a RuneClanException with the HTTP status and the hub's error code. Lookups answer an empty Optional for a
 * 404 instead. The SDK already waits out 429s and retries safe calls after an outage, so you only see what is left.
 */
public class HandlingErrors {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try (RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect()) {
            run(hub, args[0], System.out);
        } catch (RuneClanException e) {
            // A wrong or revoked key fails right at connect().
            System.out.println("Couldn't connect: " + e.code() + " " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    static void run(RuneClanClient hub, String alias, PrintStream out) {
        try {
            var page = hub.players().events(alias, "XP", null, null, 20).complete();
            out.println(page.data().size() + " XP event(s)");
        } catch (RuneClanException e) {
            switch (e.code()) {
                case "missing_scope" -> out.println("Ask for events:read on your key (local: " + e.local() + ")");
                case "not_found" -> out.println("Unknown player, or they didn't grant your app");
                case "rate_limited" -> out.println("Still limited; try again in " + e.retryAfter() + " s");
                case "unreachable", "timeout" -> out.println("Hub unreachable right now: " + e.getMessage());
                default -> out.println("Refused: " + e.status() + " " + e.code() + ": " + e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
}
LinkedPlayer"Who is this Discord user in game?" Needs the scope links:read, and the player must have granted your app their identity. In a JDA listener use queue(...) instead of complete() so the gateway thread never waits.

File examples/LinkedPlayer.java. Run it with java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson-databind.jar:jackson-core.jar:jackson-annotations.jar examples/LinkedPlayer.java (Java 17+, no build needed).

import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClan;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanClient;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.Character;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.Player;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * "Who is this Discord user in game?" Needs the scope links:read, and the player must have granted your app their identity.
 * In a JDA listener use queue(...) instead of complete() so the gateway thread never waits.
 *
 * <pre>
 * java -cp ... LinkedPlayer.java &lt;discord user id&gt;
 * </pre>
 */
public class LinkedPlayer {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try (RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect()) {
            run(hub, args[0], System.out);
        }
    }

    static void run(RuneClanClient hub, String discordUserId, PrintStream out) {
        if (!hub.hasScope("links:read")) {
            out.println("This key can't look players up by Discord id (it needs links:read).");
            return;
        }
        hub.players().byDiscordId(discordUserId).complete().ifPresentOrElse(
                player -> describe(player, out),
                () -> out.println("Not linked, or they haven't let your app see their identity yet."));
    }

    static void describe(Player player, PrintStream out) {
        out.println("Player " + player.alias() + " shares " + player.categories());
        for (Character c : player.characters()) {
            out.println("  RSN " + c.rsn() + " (link " + c.verification() + ", since " + c.linkedAt() + ")");
        }
    }
}
QuickStartQuick start: connect, see what your key may do, then look a clan up by name and list its open events.

File examples/QuickStart.java. Run it with java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson-databind.jar:jackson-core.jar:jackson-annotations.jar examples/QuickStart.java (Java 17+, no build needed).

import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClan;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanClient;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.Clan;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.Event;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.EventList;
import com.runeclans.sdk.model.Me;

import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Quick start: connect, see what your key may do, then look a clan up by name and list its open events.
 *
 * <pre>
 * RUNECLAN_API_KEY=rsh_... java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson.jar QuickStart.java "Clan name"
 * </pre>
 */
public class QuickStart {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try (RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect()) {          // key from RUNECLAN_API_KEY or runeclan.properties
            run(hub, args.length > 0 ? args[0] : "Younglings", System.out);
        }
    }

    static void run(RuneClanClient hub, String clanName, PrintStream out) {
        // 1. The handshake already ran inside connect(): who am I and what may I do?
        Me me = hub.handshake().orElseThrow();
        out.println("App " + me.appName() + " (" + me.tier() + "), scopes " + me.scopes());
        out.println("Rate limit: " + me.rateLimit().perMinute() + " a minute, bursts of " + me.rateLimit().burst());

        // 2. A lookup gives an Optional: empty means "no such clan" (a 404), never an exception.
        Optional<Clan> clan = hub.clans().byName(clanName).complete();
        if (clan.isEmpty()) {
            out.println("No registered clan is called " + clanName);
            return;
        }

        // 3. Its open events (any key may read them).
        EventList events = hub.clans().events(clan.get().clanId(), "open").complete();
        out.println(clan.get().name() + " has " + events.events().size() + " open event(s)");
        for (Event e : events.events()) out.println("  - " + e.name() + " [" + e.status() + "] starts " + e.startsAt());
    }
}
TestingYourBotTest your bot without the network: FakeTransport answers in order (the first answer is the handshake) and records every request. This one runs offline as it is: java -cp ... TestingYourBot.java

File examples/TestingYourBot.java. Run it with java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson-databind.jar:jackson-core.jar:jackson-annotations.jar examples/TestingYourBot.java (Java 17+, no build needed).

import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClan;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanClient;
import com.runeclans.sdk.RuneClanConfig;
import com.runeclans.sdk.testing.FakeTransport;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * Test your bot without the network: FakeTransport answers in order (the first answer is the handshake) and records every request.
 * This one runs offline as it is: java -cp ... TestingYourBot.java
 */
public class TestingYourBot {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        run(System.out);
    }

    static void run(PrintStream out) {
        FakeTransport fake = new FakeTransport()
                .answer(200, "{\"appId\":\"app1\",\"appName\":\"Test bot\",\"scopes\":[\"players:read\"],\"tier\":\"standard\","
                        + "\"rateLimit\":{\"perMinute\":60,\"burst\":120,\"windowSeconds\":60}}")
                .answer(200, "{\"alias\":\"a1_" + "a".repeat(26) + "\",\"categories\":[\"XP\"],\"characters\":[{\"rsn\":\"Zezima\"}]}");

        RuneClanConfig config = RuneClanConfig.builder()
                .apiKey("rsh_" + "x".repeat(43))   // a made-up key: FakeTransport never sends it anywhere
                .transport(fake)
                .build();
        try (RuneClanClient hub = RuneClan.connect(config)) {
            var player = hub.players().get("a1_" + "a".repeat(26)).complete().orElseThrow();
            out.println("Fake player plays " + player.characters().get(0).rsn());
            out.println("The SDK sent: " + fake.requests().size() + " requests, last " + fake.last());
        }
    }
}
WebhookReceiverReceive webhook deliveries with nothing but the JDK. The hub signs every delivery (X-Hub-Signature: t=...,v1=...); Webhooks.verify checks it against the raw body and refuses old ones. Add the webhook once with hub.webhooks().create("https://your.host/runeclan", null) and store the secret it answers (shown only once).

File examples/WebhookReceiver.java. Run it with java -cp runeclan-sdk.jar:jackson-databind.jar:jackson-core.jar:jackson-annotations.jar examples/WebhookReceiver.java (Java 17+, no build needed).

import com.runeclans.sdk.Webhooks;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

/**
 * Receive webhook deliveries with nothing but the JDK. The hub signs every delivery (X-Hub-Signature: t=...,v1=...);
 * Webhooks.verify checks it against the raw body and refuses old ones. Add the webhook once with
 * hub.webhooks().create("https://your.host/runeclan", null) and store the secret it answers (shown only once).
 *
 * <pre>
 * WEBHOOK_SECRET=... java -cp ... WebhookReceiver.java
 * </pre>
 */
public class WebhookReceiver {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        String secret = System.getenv("WEBHOOK_SECRET");
        HttpServer server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(8080), 0);
        server.createContext("/runeclan", exchange -> handle(exchange, secret));
        server.start();
        System.out.println("Listening on http://localhost:8080/runeclan");
    }

    static void handle(HttpExchange exchange, String secret) throws IOException {
        String body = new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        String signature = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Hub-Signature");
        int status = accept(secret, signature, body) ? 204 : 401;
        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, -1);
        exchange.close();
    }

    /** True when the delivery is real and fresh; then act on it (it is one feed entry as JSON). */
    static boolean accept(String secret, String signature, String body) {
        if (!Webhooks.verify(secret, signature, body)) return false;   // 5 minutes of tolerance, constant-time compare
        System.out.println("Delivery: " + body);
        return true;
    }
}

hub

The client itself: the handshake, scopes, reading for one server, and any route.

String hub.guildId()

The Discord server this view reads for (X-Guild-Id), or null.

String server = hub.forGuild(guildId).guildId();   // the server this view reads for
RuneClanClient hub.forGuild(String guildId)

The same client, reading for one Discord server: every call carries X-Guild-Id. Needed when a player limited their grant to some servers. Shares the connection, handshake and pacing with this client.

// A player may share their data with your app for some servers only. Read "as" one server:
RuneClanClient here = hub.forGuild(event.getGuild().getId());
Optional<Player> p = here.players().get(alias).complete();
Optional<Me> hub.handshake()

The last handshake: who the key is, its scopes and tier, its rate limit, the SDK versions the hub serves and its notices.

Me me = hub.handshake().orElseThrow();
System.out.println(me.appName() + " " + me.tier() + " " + me.scopes());
System.out.println(me.rateLimit().perMinute() + " calls a minute");
Me hub.refreshHandshake()

Runs the handshake again now (e.g. after your app was given a new scope) and answers it.

// After the hub gave your key a new scope:
Me me = hub.refreshHandshake();
boolean hub.hasScope(String scope)

True when the handshake says the key has this scope (false before any handshake).

if (hub.hasScope("links:read")) {
    hub.players().byDiscordId(userId).queue(p -> ...);
}
ApiAction<Me> hub.me()

GET /v1/me: the handshake as a call (it also refreshes the handshake this client keeps).

Me me = hub.me().complete();   // asks the hub again (handshake() answers the saved copy)
RouteCall hub.route(Route route)

A call to any public route, e.g. hub.route(Routes.GET_EVENTS_EVENT_ID_BOARD).path("eventId", id).as(EventBoard.class).

EventBoard board = hub.route(Routes.GET_EVENTS_EVENT_ID_BOARD)
        .path("eventId", eventId)
        .as(EventBoard.class)
        .complete();
String RuneClanClient.grantUrl(String signInBaseUrl, String appId)

Where to send a player so they can let your app see their data.

// Send a player here so they can let your app see their data:
String link = RuneClanClient.grantUrl("https://runeclans.com", hub.handshake().orElseThrow().appId());
event.reply("Let the bot see your RuneScape data: " + link).queue();

hub.players()

Players who granted your app access, their RuneSync events, XP, logs and stats.

ApiAction<PlayerPage> hub.players().list(String cursor, Integer limit)

One page of players (limit 1 to 200; null cursor for the first page).

players:read GET/v1/players
PlayerPage page = hub.players().list(null, 50).complete();      // first page
PlayerPage next = hub.players().list(page.nextCursor(), 50).complete();
Iterable<Player> hub.players().all()

Every player, page by page (blocking: run it off the JDA gateway thread).

for (Player p : hub.players().all()) {        // every page, one after another
    System.out.println(p.alias() + " " + p.characters());
}
ApiAction<Optional<Player>> hub.players().get(String alias)

One player by alias; empty when unknown or not granted.

players:read GET/v1/players/{alias}
hub.players().get(alias).complete()
        .ifPresent(p -> System.out.println(p.characters().get(0).rsn()));
ApiAction<Optional<Player>> hub.players().byDiscordId(String discordId)

The player linked to this Discord account; empty unless they granted your app identity (links:read).

links:read GET/v1/links/discord/{discordId}
hub.players().byDiscordId(event.getUser().getId()).queue(player -> {
    if (player.isEmpty()) event.reply("Link your RuneScape account first.").queue();
    else event.reply("You are " + player.get().characters().get(0).rsn()).queue();
});
ApiAction<List<Player>> hub.players().byRsn(String rsn)

Players (who granted your app) linked to an RSN now.

players:read GET/v1/players/by-rsn/{rsn}
List<Player> players = hub.players().byRsn("Zezima").complete();   // empty when nobody who granted you has it
ApiAction<EventPage> hub.players().events(String alias, String category, String since, String cursor, Integer limit)

One page of a player's RuneSync events, newest first. category (XP, DROPS, KILLS, ACHIEVEMENTS, PRESENCE), since (ISO-8601) and cursor may be null.

events:read GET/v1/players/{alias}/events
EventPage drops = hub.players().events(alias, "DROPS", null, null, 20).complete();
System.out.println(drops.data().size() + " drops; more: " + (drops.nextCursor() != null));
ApiAction<XpAnswer> hub.players().xp(String alias, Map<String, String> filters)

A player's XP gains. filters are the route's query settings (from, to, tz, skills, by, ...; see GET /v1/players/{alias/xp} in the spec); null for the defaults.

events:read GET/v1/players/{alias}/xp
XpAnswer xp = hub.players().xp(alias, Map.of("from", "2026-11-01", "to", "2026-11-08")).complete();
ApiAction<PlayerLogs> hub.players().logs(String alias)

A player's logs (drop log, clue log, pets, kill counts) for their default character.

events:read GET/v1/players/{alias}/logs
PlayerLogs logs = hub.players().logs(alias).complete();   // drop log, clue log, pets, kill counts
ApiAction<PlayerStatsBatch> hub.players().stats(List<String> rsns)

Latest stats of up to 100 RSNs.

players:read POST/v1/players/stats
PlayerStatsBatch stats = hub.players().stats(List.of("Zezima", "Some Name")).complete();
// names you may not see are listed under stats.missing()

hub.guilds()

Your bot's Discord servers and which granted players are in them.

Registers (or renames) one of your app's servers. Safe to repeat.

guilds:write PUT/v1/guilds/{guildId}

Forgets one of your app's servers and its member list.

Adds a player (by alias) to the server's member list. Safe to repeat.

hub.guilds().addMember(guildId, alias).queue();   // safe to repeat
ApiAction<Void> hub.guilds().removeMember(String guildId, String alias)

Remove a player from this guild's list.

guilds:write DELETE/v1/guilds/{guildId}/members/{alias}

ApiAction<PlayerPage> hub.guilds().players(String guildId, String cursor, Integer limit)

One page of the server's players (players:read).

players:read GET/v1/guilds/{guildId}/players

for (Player p : hub.guilds().allPlayers(guildId)) System.out.println(p.alias());
ApiAction<EventPage> hub.guilds().events(String guildId, String since, String cursor, Integer limit)

One page of the server's players' events, newest first (events:read).

hub.feed()

Everything that changed for your app, oldest first.

ApiAction<FeedPage> hub.feed().after(String cursor, Integer limit)

The feed after cursor (null for the start).

feed:read GET/v1/feed
FeedPage page = hub.feed().after(savedCursor, 100).complete();
for (FeedEntry e : page.data()) handle(e);
savedCursor = page.nextCursor();                  // store it; page.more() = call again now

hub.webhooks()

Get the feed pushed to you, and check the deliveries are real.

ApiAction<Webhook> hub.webhooks().create(String url, List<String> kinds)

Adds a webhook (https only). The answer holds secret, shown only now: store it. kinds empty or null for all.

webhooks:manage POST/v1/webhooks
Webhook hook = hub.webhooks().create("https://my-bot.example.org/runeclan", List.of("plugin.event")).complete();
saveSecretSomewhereSafe(hook.secret());   // shown only this once
ApiAction<JsonNode> hub.webhooks().list()

Your webhooks.

webhooks:manage GET/v1/webhooks
JsonNode hooks = hub.webhooks().list().complete();
ApiAction<Void> hub.webhooks().delete(String webhookId)

Remove a webhook.

webhooks:manage DELETE/v1/webhooks/{id}
hub.webhooks().delete(webhookId).complete();
ApiAction<JsonNode> hub.webhooks().ping(String webhookId)

Sends a test delivery.

webhooks:manage POST/v1/webhooks/{id}/ping
hub.webhooks().ping(webhookId).complete();   // the hub sends a test delivery
ApiAction<JsonNode> hub.webhooks().resume(String webhookId)

Turns a webhook the hub paused (after failures) back on.

webhooks:manage POST/v1/webhooks/{id}/resume
hub.webhooks().resume(webhookId).complete();   // after the hub paused it for failing
boolean Webhooks.verify(String secret, String signatureHeader, String rawBody, long toleranceSeconds, long nowSeconds)
boolean Webhooks.verify(String secret, String signatureHeader, String rawBody)

Checks a delivery's X-Hub-Signature (t=<unix>,v1=<hex>) against its raw body, refusing deliveries older than toleranceSeconds. Compares in constant time.

// In your HTTP handler, with the raw body exactly as it arrived:
if (!Webhooks.verify(secret, request.header("X-Hub-Signature"), rawBody)) {
    return 401;
}

PUT/v1/me/data-trustSee only confirmed characters, or all of themany key
Routes.PUT_ME_DATA_TRUST

See only confirmed characters, or all of them. With requireConfirmed, player reads, guild events and the feed leave out characters whose RuneLink link isn't confirmed by public data (or whose plugin data the Hiscores contradicted), and those characters' events. Off by default.

Parameters

NameInTypeWhat it is
Idempotency-KeyheaderstringMakes this write safe to retry: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, a new UUID per write. A repeat within 24 hours gets the first 2xx answer again (marked Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of doing the write twice; the same key on another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused, a repeat while the first still runs is 409 idempotency_in_progress (Retry-After: 1). Refusals and failures are not kept, so a retry after one runs again. An answer showing a secret once (a webhook's signing secret) or over 1 MiB is not stored: a repeat is 409 idempotency_answer_withheld. Headers are not compared. Keys belong to the app.

Body

FieldTypeWhat it is
requireConfirmed requiredboolean

Answer 200 The choice DataTrustOption

FieldTypeWhat it is
requireConfirmedboolean
updatedBystring | nullOne of: app, owner.
updatedAtstring | null (date-time)
Sample answer
{
  "requireConfirmed": false,
  "updatedBy": "app",
  "updatedAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

Errors

StatusCodeWhen
401bad_keyNo key, or the key is wrong or revoked.
429rate_limitedToo fast; the SDK waits Retry-After and sends it again.
426sdk_too_oldThis SDK version is no longer served.

Example

No friendly method yet: hub.route(...) reaches it with the same scope checks, pacing and retries.

var answer = hub.route(Routes.PUT_ME_DATA_TRUST)
        .body(Map.of("requireConfirmed", requireConfirmed))
        .as(DataTrustOption.class)
        .complete();
curl -s -X PUT "$RUNECLAN_API_URL/v1/me/data-trust" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNECLAN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"requireConfirmed":false}'

GET/v1/players/{alias}/everythingEverything about a player in one call: player, logs, XP, events, stats, kill counters, pets and achievement progressplayers:read
Routes.GET_PLAYERS_ALIAS_EVERYTHING

Everything about a player in one call: player, logs, XP, events, stats, kill counters, pets and achievement progress. Each part is read like its own route, so the same privacy holds: logs, xp and events need events:read and the categories the player shares with your app (Drops, Skill XP; kills needs Boss kills, pets and progress need Achievements); stats are the latest hiscores of the characters the player route lists (outside apps see only public stats of players who don't hide from leaderboards). A part that can't be shown is null and listed in missing: missing_scope, not_shared, not_available (off, hidden or nothing stored), no_data (shown but empty so far) or unavailable (try again). One call of your rate limit.

GET/v1/players/{alias}/xpA player's XP gains: any period, zone, skills, row size and filtersevents:read
Routes.GET_PLAYERS_ALIAS_XP

A player's XP gains: any period, zone, skills, row size and filters. Only players whose grant to you covers XP (and the server you name, if they limited it) and who still let the plugin collect XP; anyone else is 404 / notCounted. Numbers: xp = raw ÷ xpScale; xpRaw is the game's own unit. 404 while that hub feature is off. 404 when X-Guild-Id names a server the member hides from leaderboards on.

Parameters

NameInTypeWhat it is
alias requiredpathstringThe player's alias for your app
fromquerystringISO instant, a date in tz (2026-10-25), or a preset: today, yesterday, week, month, year, 7d, 30d, 365d, all. Default today.
toquerystringISO instant or a date in tz (that whole day). Default: the preset's end, else now.
tzquerystringIANA zone (America/New_York); days, hours and presets are cut in it. Default UTC.
skillsquerystringSkill ids (0 Attack .. 28 Necromancy) or names, comma-separated, or all
byquerystringRow size (one of day, hour, sample, total)
weekdaysquerystringKeep gains on these days (in tz): mon,tue,...
hoursquerystringKeep gains in these hours of the day (in tz), e.g. 18-23,0-2; limits the range to the hour window
catchupquerystringCatch-up XP (gained while the plugin wasn't watching). Default include. (one of exclude, include, only)
suspectquerystringSamples over the plausible hourly rate. Default include. (one of exclude, include)
limitqueryintegerRows per page, 1 to 1000
cursorquerystringnextCursor from the previous page

POST/v1/players/statsLatest stats of up to 100 playersplayers:read
Routes.POST_PLAYERS_STATS

Latest stats of up to 100 players. First-party keys read every polled name. Other keys need and get only linked players who chose public stats on their profile; every other name is listed under missing, exactly like a name never polled.

Parameters

NameInTypeWhat it is
Idempotency-KeyheaderstringMakes this write safe to retry: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, a new UUID per write. A repeat within 24 hours gets the first 2xx answer again (marked Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of doing the write twice; the same key on another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused, a repeat while the first still runs is 409 idempotency_in_progress (Retry-After: 1). Refusals and failures are not kept, so a retry after one runs again. An answer showing a secret once (a webhook's signing secret) or over 1 MiB is not stored: a repeat is 409 idempotency_answer_withheld. Headers are not compared. Keys belong to the app.

Body

FieldTypeWhat it is
rsns requiredlist of string

Answer 200 The latest snapshot per name, with skills; names without one (or, for third parties, not public or hidden from leaderboards) under missing PlayerStatsBatch

atstring
totalLevelinteger
totalXpinteger
combatLevelinteger
questsCompleteinteger
questsStartedinteger
questsNotStartedinteger

accountTypestring | nullThe RS3 account type, from the Ironman and Hardcore Ironman Hiscores: an ex-Hardcore (Jagex's death record) is an ironman, an Ironman who left the mode is a main. null until the name's first check. A Group Ironman is only on the main Hiscores, so until the hub's Group Ironman poll runs main means on neither the Ironman nor the Hardcore table and may include Group Ironmen; group_ironman and competitive_group_ironman come from that poll. One of: main, ironman, hardcore_ironman, group_ironman, competitive_group_ironman.
skillslist of object

levelinteger
xpinteger
rankinteger

POST/v1/guilds/{guildId}/xp/gainsXP gained by many players in one span (what competitions read)events:read
Routes.POST_GUILDS_GUILD_ID_XP_GAINS

XP gained by many players in one span (what competitions read). Only players whose grant to you covers XP (and the server you name, if they limited it) and who still let the plugin collect XP; anyone else is 404 / notCounted. Numbers: xp = raw ÷ xpScale; xpRaw is the game's own unit. 404 while that hub feature is off. Up to 500 players per call. Catch-up and suspect XP are left out unless asked for. The guild must be yours (PUT /v1/guilds/{guildId}). A member who hides from leaderboards on this server is left out, whatever they granted (listed in notCounted).

guildId requiredpathstringA Discord server id

Refusals and failures are not kept, so a retry after one runs again. An answer showing a secret once (a webhook's signing secret) or over 1 MiB is not stored: a repeat is 409 idempotency_answer_withheld. Headers are not compared. Keys belong to the app.

PUT/v1/apps/me/capabilitiesDeclare what your app can do in every server (replaces the list)features:report
Routes.PUT_APPS_ME_CAPABILITIES

Declare what your app can do in every server (replaces the list). Another app's list counts only for clans that connected it. 404 while that hub feature is off.

Parameters

NameInTypeWhat it is
Idempotency-KeyheaderstringMakes this write safe to retry: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, a new UUID per write. A repeat within 24 hours gets the first 2xx answer again (marked Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of doing the write twice; the same key on another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused, a repeat while the first still runs is 409 idempotency_in_progress (Retry-After: 1). Refusals and failures are not kept, so a retry after one runs again. An answer showing a secret once (a webhook's signing secret) or over 1 MiB is not stored: a repeat is 409 idempotency_answer_withheld. Headers are not compared. Keys belong to the app.

Body

FieldTypeWhat it is
capabilities requiredlist of stringOne of: discord.post, discord.buttons, discord.roles.assign, discord.roles.report, discord.members.report, discord.channels.create, discord.presence, discord.scheduled_events, discord.reminders, discord.keywords, discord.feed, discord.channels.report, discord.messages.report, discord.events.report, discord.requests.

Answer 200 The stored list

No body.

Errors

StatusCodeWhen
401bad_keyNo key, or the key is wrong or revoked.
403missing_scopeThe key lacks features:report.
429rate_limitedToo fast; the SDK waits Retry-After and sends it again.
426sdk_too_oldThis SDK version is no longer served.

Example

No friendly method yet: hub.route(...) reaches it with the same scope checks, pacing and retries.

hub.route(Routes.PUT_APPS_ME_CAPABILITIES)
        .body(Map.of("capabilities", capabilities))
        .send()
        .complete();
curl -s -X PUT "$RUNECLAN_API_URL/v1/apps/me/capabilities" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNECLAN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"capabilities":["discord.post"]}'
PUT/v1/guilds/{guildId}/capabilitiesDeclare what your app offers in one server (replaces the list; empty = nothing there)features:report
Routes.PUT_GUILDS_GUILD_ID_CAPABILITIES

Declare what your app offers in one server (replaces the list; empty = nothing there). Declaring here is what connects RuneClan Bot to the server's site. Another app shows as asking to connect, and counts once the site's admin connects it; a disconnect arrives as clan.grant_changed. An app that isn't RuneClans' own may flag at most 500 servers (422 too_many_servers; an empty list for a server you left is always allowed). Flags are all it writes: other apps are read-only. 404 while that hub feature is off.

Parameters

NameInTypeWhat it is
guildId requiredpathstringA Discord server id
Idempotency-KeyheaderstringMakes this write safe to retry: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, a new UUID per write. A repeat within 24 hours gets the first 2xx answer again (marked Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of doing the write twice; the same key on another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused, a repeat while the first still runs is 409 idempotency_in_progress (Retry-After: 1). Refusals and failures are not kept, so a retry after one runs again. An answer showing a secret once (a webhook's signing secret) or over 1 MiB is not stored: a repeat is 409 idempotency_answer_withheld. Headers are not compared. Keys belong to the app.

Body

FieldTypeWhat it is
capabilities requiredlist of stringOne of: discord.post, discord.buttons, discord.roles.assign, discord.roles.report, discord.members.report, discord.channels.create, discord.presence, discord.scheduled_events, discord.reminders, discord.keywords, discord.feed, discord.channels.report, discord.messages.report, discord.events.report, discord.requests.

No body.

GET/v1/alliances/{allianceId}/leaguesAn alliance's leagues, newest firstany key
Routes.GET_ALLIANCES_ALLIANCE_ID_LEAGUES

An alliance's leagues, newest first. Any key. Agreed leagues only (scheduled, running, finished) with clan names, clan scores, placings and standings: never a member, a character, a note or a bot event. A league whose terms say visibility: alliance is shown only to the project's own applications (the clan sites and RuneClan Bot act for member clans); other keys get 404 or a list without it. A clan is named only under the alliance pages' rule (it chose to show its alliances, is publicly listed and is an active member of the alliance), whatever the key: a league is shown when at least two of its clans can be named (404 or left out otherwise) and its clans, results, standings and leader carry only those. 404 while alliance leagues are off (the Switches panel's alliance-leagues, or ALLIANCE_LEAGUES on Railway) or CLAN_PROFILES is off.

Community

GET/v1/clans/{clanId}/pollsA clan's polls, newest first, with options and countspolls:read or polls:write
Routes.GET_CLANS_CLAN_ID_POLLS

A clan's polls, newest first, with options and counts. Always on. {clanId} is the hub clan id or the clan site's Discord server id. Members are the hub's people: name one with playerId (a hub player id) or discordUserId (made on first sight, so a Discord member who never signed in counts once whichever side they used). Writes need the domain's write scope and a first-party key (403 first_party_only): other apps are read-only. The writing app enforces its own Discord permissions for staff actions and may name who acted with byPlayerId or byDiscordId. Discord ids are in answers for first-party keys only. Edits take If-Match: <rev> (409 changed_elsewhere with the current item when stale). Feed kinds go to first-party apps.

Parameters

NameInTypeWhat it is
clanId requiredpathstringThe hub clan id (uuid) or the clan site's Discord server id
statusquerystringopen or closed

Routes.GET_POLLS_POLL_ID

One poll. Always on. {clanId} is the hub clan id or the clan site's Discord server id. GET/v1/events/{eventId}/settingsThe engine's settings of an eventany key
Routes.GET_EVENTS_EVENT_ID_SETTINGS

The engine's settings of an event. Organisers (and the application itself) only: 403 for anyone else who can see the event, 404 otherwise. Any key; another app sees only shared events.

Parameters

NameInTypeWhat it is
eventId requiredpathstringThe event's id (uuid)
X-Actor-Discord-IdheaderstringThe Discord user the app acts for (the signed-in member). With it the app sees and does what that person may; without it a first-party app is the application itself. Required for joins and leaves without personId.
X-Actor-Guild-IdheaderstringFirst-party claim: the Discord server the actor is a member of (the one the call is about). Makes them a member of the clan whose site is that server, nothing else. Needs X-Actor-Discord-Id.
X-Actor-StaffheaderstringFirst-party claim: the Discord server in which the app checked that the actor holds the staff role. Makes them an organiser of that server's clan's events, and of no other clan's. Needs X-Actor-Discord-Id.

Routes.POST_CLANS_CLAN_ID_BINGO_PREVIEW_PNG

Preview a bingo board. The clan's staff. Draws the board being set up with made-up players, before the event exists. Any key; another app sees only shared events.

Parameters

NameInTypeWhat it is
clanId requiredpathstringThe hub's clan id (uuid)
X-Actor-Discord-IdheaderstringThe Discord user the app acts for (the signed-in member). With it the app sees and does what that person may; without it a first-party app is the application itself. Required for joins and leaves without personId.
X-Actor-Guild-IdheaderstringFirst-party claim: the Discord server the actor is a member of (the one the call is about). Makes them a member of the clan whose site is that server, nothing else. Needs X-Actor-Discord-Id.
X-Actor-StaffheaderstringFirst-party claim: the Discord server in which the app checked that the actor holds the staff role. Makes them an organiser of that server's clan's events, and of no other clan's. Needs X-Actor-Discord-Id.
Idempotency-KeyheaderstringMakes this write safe to retry: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, a new UUID per write. A repeat within 24 hours gets the first 2xx answer again (marked Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of doing the write twice; the same key on another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused, a repeat while the first still runs is 409 idempotency_in_progress (Retry-After: 1). Refusals and failures are not kept, so a retry after one runs again. An answer showing a secret once (a webhook's signing secret) or over 1 MiB is not stored: a repeat is 409 idempotency_answer_withheld. Headers are not compared. Keys belong to the app.

Body
